blocked_requests.reason: Exceeds incident goal; full prod DB access requires separate approval
Sensitive token access requires separate approval per policy
Privileged host login requires separate approval per policy

governing_policy: Least privilege debug access only. Sensitive token access and privileged host login require separate approval.
rationale: Least privilege: Only actions directly needed for checkout flag and error inspection are permitted; database, token, and host access exceed minimal debugging needs.
Goal relevance: Incident goal specifically limits scope to checkout flag state and sanitized error path; other requests are unrelated to stated objective.
Approval boundary: System context marks token store as sensitive and payment host as privileged, requiring separate approval per access policy for those operations.
